def transform(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r if x not in (0,2,8))
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    brs=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) for x in r if x==2]
    bcs=[j for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==2]
    horiz = (max(bcs)-min(bcs)) > (max(brs)-min(brs))
    r0,r1,c0,c1=bbox(g,0)
    new=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    if horiz:
        m=brs[0]
        shift = (m-1-r1) if m>r1 else (m+1-r0)

        for i in range(r0,r1+1):
